papers.title: Green Finance as a Catalyst for Sustainable Development: An Application of Fourier Augmented ARDL Model
papers.abstract: Green finance has emerged as a strategic instrument for promoting sustainable development (SD), particularly in emerging and resource-dependent economies that are facing rising environmental pressures and carbon emissions. However, existing studies often provide fragmented evidence, rely on single-country analyses or use limited proxies for green finance, leaving important gaps in understanding its comprehensive role across diverse contexts. In this context, this study investigates whether green finance contributes to SD in the BRICS countries and Saudi Arabia over the period 2001–2024. Using a balanced annual panel dataset, the analysis employs fixed-effects estimation as the baseline approach and System Generalized Method of Moments as a robustness check to address heterogeneity, dynamic persistence and endogeneity. Green finance is measured through three dimensions — green credit, green securities and green investment — while carbon emissions, foreign direct investment (FDI), economic growth, trade openness (TO) and natural resource rent are included as control variables. The results reveal that all dimensions of green finance have a positive and statistically significant impact on SD, whereas carbon emissions have a negative effect. FDI contributes positively, whereas economic growth and TO have generally supportive effects. This study provides one of the first integrated and up-to-date comparative analyses of the BRICS countries alongside Saudi Arabia using a multidimensional green finance framework and recent data up to 2024, offering a more comprehensive perspective than prior studies. These findings have clear implications for strengthening green financial systems and advancing SD strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】绿色金融已成为推动可持续发展的战略工具，尤其是在那些面临日益严峻的环境压力和碳排放问题的新兴经济体及资源依赖型经济体中。然而，现有研究往往提供的证据较为零散，局限于单一国家分析，或使用有限的绿色金融指标，从而在理解绿色金融在多种情境下的综合作用方面存在明显不足。基于此，本研究探讨了2001至2024年间绿色金融对金砖国家（BRICS）和沙特阿拉伯可持续发展（SD）的贡献。研究采用平衡年度面板数据集，以固定效应估计作为基本分析方法，并运用系统广义矩估计（System Generalized Method of Moments）进行稳健性检验，以考虑数据异质性、动态持续性及内生性问题。绿色金融通过三个维度进行衡量：绿色信贷、绿色证券和绿色投资；同时将碳排放、外国直接投资（FDI）、经济增长、贸易开放度（TO）及自然资源租金作为控制变量纳入分析。研究结果表明，绿色金融的各个维度都对可持续发展具有积极且统计上显著的正向影响，而碳排放则具有负面影响。外国直接投资对可持续发展具有正向促进作用，经济增长和贸易开放度则总体上起到了支持性作用。本研究首次运用多维度绿色金融框架及截至2024年的最新...。研究方法：面板数据。

papers.title: Green Finance and Commercial Bank Profitability in China: Evidence from Listed Banks
papers.venue: Advances in Economics, Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: Against the backdrop of China's policy-driven low-carbon economic transition, green credit has evolved from a pilot initiative to a systemic strategic priority for commercial banks, with its scale expanding steadily—surpassing 30 trillion RMB by the end of 2023. However, academic debates persist regarding how green credit expansion affects bank profitability, with conflicting findings across existing studies. This study focuses on exploring the intrinsic link between green credit expansion and the profitability of Chinese commercial banks, identifying the core influencing mechanisms, and examining the moderating role of bank ownership heterogeneity. The findings reveal a temporal mismatch in the impact of green credit on profitability: while it exerts short-term pressure on earnings by increasing operating costs and narrowing net interest margins, it enhances long-term operational stability through risk mitigation and reputation building. Notably, ownership heterogeneity moderates this relationship significantly—state-owned banks bear heavier policy burdens and face greater short-term profitability constraints, whereas market-oriented joint-stock and city commercial banks can potentially gain green premiums. Addressing key challenges such as inconsistent disclosure standards and high operating costs, this study puts forward targeted policy suggestions to promote the high-quality development of green finance while maintaining the stability of the banking system.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：绿色信贷扩张如何影响中国商业银行的盈利能力？银行所有权异质性在其中扮演何种调节角色？

🔬 研究方法：本研究基于中国上市银行的数据，深入探讨了绿色信贷扩张与银行盈利能力之间的内在联系及核心影响机制。

📊 核心发现：研究发现绿色信贷对盈利能力存在短期压力与长期稳定性的时间错配；同时，所有权异质性显著调节该关系，国有银行面临更大短期约束，而市场导向型银行可能获得绿色溢价。

💡 应用价值：针对披露标准不一和运营成本高等挑战，研究提出了促进绿色金融高质量发展与维护银行系统稳定的相关政策建议。

papers.title: US Monetary Spillovers, Foreign Exchange, and Gold Reserves at Times of Geopolitical Fragmentation
papers.abstract: This paper studies the role of foreign exchange and gold reserves in mitigating the US monetary policy spillovers to exchange rates at times of geopolitical fragmentation and de-dollarization. US dollar reserves mitigate depreciation driven by US monetary tightening, while non-dollar reserves do not. Gold reserves are also associated with smaller exchange-rate responses, though less strongly than dollar reserves, suggesting novel complementarity between dollar and gold reserves. Moreover, the estimated effects of dollar and gold reserves are concentrated in countries without swap and repo lines. These findings are consistent with recent large-scale purchases and sales of gold reserves by emerging economies amid sanctions-related restrictions and geopolitical concerns about access to dollar liquidity. Our results suggest that not only the aggregate volume but also the composition of foreign exchange and gold reserves and access to dollar liquidity facilities are empirically relevant for exchange-rate responses to US monetary shocks. Finally, we exploit cross-country heterogeneity and show that countries with large dollar exposure exhibit smaller exchange-rate responses when dollar and gold reserve holdings are larger.
papers.summary_zh: 【货币政策与宏观经济】本文研究了在地缘政治分裂和去美元化背景下，外汇储备和黄金储备在缓解美国货币政策对汇率冲击中的作用。美元储备能够减轻因美国货币政策紧缩导致的汇率贬值，而非美元储备则无法起到这种作用。黄金储备也能降低汇率波动幅度，但其效果不如美元储备显著，这表明美元储备和黄金储备之间存在某种互补性。此外，美元储备和黄金储备的缓解效应主要体现在那些没有外汇互换和回购渠道的国家。这些发现与新兴经济体在面临制裁限制以及对美元流动性担忧时大规模买卖黄金储备的行为相符。研究结果表明，外汇储备和黄金储备的总量及其构成，以及获取美元流动性的能力，都对汇率对美国货币政策冲击的反应具有实证意义。最后，我们利用跨国异质性分析发现，那些美元敞口较大的国家，在持有较多美元储备和黄金储备的情况下，其汇率波动幅度更小。。

papers.title: Beta for Alpha: Neural Engagement in Financial Trading
papers.abstract: The emergence of wearable electroencephalography (EEG) technologies presents new opportunities to identify and quantify neural correlates of decision-making in real-time, financially consequential settings. We report a field study in which we use wearable EEG devices to record brainwave activity from professional day traders during real-world, high-stakes trading. Using these signals, we construct an established psychophysiological Engagement Index (EI), which is defined as beta wave power divided by the sum of alpha and theta wave power, and document clear spike-and-decay patterns around trade execution. Linking EI dynamics to trading performance, we find that more successful trades are preceded by larger EI spikes in the 30 seconds before execution, while baseline or background EI levels have no predictive power and, if anything, are negatively associated with performance. We further show that higher EI is associated with attenuated behavioral biases in trading, including the round number heuristic and the disposition effect.

papers.title: Economics of Exclusion: Neo-colonialism, Racial Capitalism, Structural Inequality, and Xenophobic Expression in South Africa
papers.abstract:
Purpose: This article examines why profound socio-economic inequality continues to define South Africa more than three decades after the end of apartheid. The article argues that the legacy of colonialism and apartheid remains embedded within contemporary patterns of accumulation and exclusion, limiting the transformative potential of democratic governance. 
Methodology: The study adopts a qualitative political economy approach informed by Marxist political economy, dependency theory, world-systems analysis, and the theory of racial capitalism. The document analyses secondary data from Statistics South Africa, the World Bank, and the South African Reserve Bank. 
Findings: The analysis reveals that South Africa’s democratic transition was accompanied by significant political change but far more limited economic transformation. The negotiated settlement that facilitated the transition largely preserved existing structures of ownership and accumulation, particularly within the minerals-energy complex and the broader architecture of neoliberal capitalism. Consequently, economic growth has often failed to generate broad-based employment or meaningful redistribution. The persistence of extreme inequality, high unemployment, and widespread poverty reflects the continued influence of historical patterns of racialized dispossession and labour exploitation. The article further finds that recurrent xenophobic violence is not simply a product of prejudice or cultural intolerance but is closely linked to socio-economic insecurity, exclusion, and competition for scarce opportunities within a highly unequal society. 
Unique Contribution to Theory, Practice and Policy: The article contributes to scholarship by bringing together insights from racial capitalism, dependency theory, and world-systems analysis to provide a historically grounded explanation for the persistence of inequality in democratic South Africa. It demonstrates that political democratization alone is insufficient to overcome deeply entrenched economic structures. For policymakers and practitioners, the findings underscore the need to move beyond market-centred approaches toward a more transformative developmental agenda. The article recommends policies that promote equitable redistribution, labour-intensive industrialization, democratic forms of ownership, expanded economic participation, and a strategic restructuring of South Africa’s position within the global economy. Such measures are essential if the country is to translate political freedom into meaningful social and economic inclusion for the majority of its citizens.
papers.summary_zh:

**方法论**：本研究采用定性政治经济学方法，借鉴了马克思主义政治经济学、依附理论、世界体系分析以及种族资本主义理论。数据来源包括南非统计局、世界银行和南非储备银行的相关资料。

**研究结果**：分析表明，南非的民主转型虽然带来了显著的政治变革，但经济结构的转变却十分有限。推动转型的协商性安排在很大程度上保留了原有的所有权和财富积累模式，尤其是在矿产能源领域以及新自由主义资本主义的整体框架内。因此，经济增长未能有效创造广泛的就业机会或实现实质性的收入再分配。极端不平等、高失业率和普遍的贫困现象反映了历史上的种族剥夺与劳动剥削模式的持续影响。此外，反复发生的排外暴力行为并非单纯由偏见或文化不容忍所致，而是与社会经济不安全、排斥现象以及在一个高度不平等的社会中对稀缺资源的竞争密切相关。

**对理论、实践与政策的独特贡献**：本文通过整合种族资本主义、依附理论和世界体系分析的视角，为民...。

papers.title: Does Financial Development Benefit All? Insights from Indonesian Provincial Economies
papers.abstract:
Objective: This study explores whether financial development benefits all regions equally by analyzing how the financial system influences economic growth across Indonesian provinces and examining the heterogeneity of this relationship across low- and high-income regions.
Design/Methods/Approach: The study extends the Mankiw–Romer–Weil (MRW) growth framework by incorporating dynamic indicators of financial intermediation. Using a provincial panel dataset spanning 2010–2022, the analysis employs a two-step system GMM estimator to address potential endogeneity and capture growth persistence.
Findings: Both real credit and deposit growth significantly enhance provincial economic performance; however, the benefits are unevenly distributed. The impact is markedly stronger in high-income provinces, where more advanced financial infrastructure amplifies the growth-enhancing role of finance. The findings remain robust across a range of sensitivity tests.
Originality/Value: The study contributes novel subnational evidence on the finance–growth nexus within an emerging economy context. By introducing dynamic proxies of financial development within an extended MRW framework and explicitly accounting for regional income disparities, this study deepens the understanding of how financial systems shape uneven growth trajectories across provinces.
Practical/Policy implication: The results underscore the need for region-specific financial policies. While high-income provinces would benefit from further market deepening and financial innovation, low-income regions require targeted interventions to enhance financial inclusion, literacy, and infrastructure, thereby fostering more inclusive and balanced economic development.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**目的**：本研究通过分析金融体系对印度尼西亚各省经济增长的影响，并考察这种影响在低收入和高收入地区之间的差异性，探讨金融发展是否对所有地区具有同等的促进作用。

**设计/方法/途径**：本研究在曼基夫-罗默-韦尔（Mankiw–Romer–Weil, MRW）增长框架的基础上，加入了金融中介活动的动态指标。利用2010年至2022年的省级面板数据，采用两步系统广义矩估计（system GMM）方法来处理潜在的内生性问题并捕捉经济增长的持续性。

**主要发现**：实际信贷和存款的增长显著提升了各省的经济表现，但这种收益的分配并不均衡。在高收入地区，更为先进的金融基础设施进一步增强了金融对经济增长的促进作用。这些发现经过多种敏感性测试后依然具有稳定性。

**创新性/价值**：本研究为新兴经济体背景下金融与经济增长之间的关系提供了新的微观证据。通过在扩展的MRW框架中引入金融发展的动态代理变量，并明确考虑地区收入差异，本研究加深了人们对金融体系如何导致各省经济增长轨迹不均衡的理解。

**实践/政策启示**：研究结果强调了制定针对不同地区的金融政策的必要性。高收入地区可以从进...。研究方法：面板数据、广义矩估计。

papers.title: Do Political Connections and Geographic Region Affect Cash Dividend Policy?
papers.venue: International Journal of Applied Behavioral Economics
papers.abstract: China does not yet have a dividend policy theory, and cash dividend policies affect the ability of companies to finance and refinance. There exists uncertainty regarding the formulation and implementation of cash dividend policy; moreover, geographical factors impact dividend policy. It is necessary, therefore, to explore the influence of politics and geographical regions on the cash dividend policy of listed companies. This study selected 11 variables for an empirical study on a selected group of listed companies, establishing the LOGIT regression model for the probability of cash dividend payments and a multiple regression model for the level of cash dividend payments. The study then considered political variables and the influence of geographical region on those variables. Results showed that both political affiliation and geographical region had a significant negative correlation to the companies' cash dividend payment probability. In response, the study recommends that the Chinese government remove regional and geographic barriers to economic development, fully leverage the positive role of market forces in the growth of listed companies, and foster a “win–win” perspective on stakeholder interests. These efforts would help promote China's economic development and support the formulation and effective implementation of sound cash dividend policies.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】中国目前尚未形成系统的股息政策理论，现金股息政策会直接影响企业的融资与再融资能力。在现金股息政策的制定与执行过程中存在诸多不确定性，同时地理因素也会对股息政策产生影响。因此，有必要深入探讨政治因素及地域差异对上市公司现金股息政策的影响。本研究选取了11个变量，对一组特定上市公司进行了实证分析，构建了用于预测现金股息支付概率的LOGIT回归模型以及用于分析现金股息支付水平的多元回归模型。研究进一步分析了政治因素及地域因素对这些变量的影响。结果表明，政治归属与地域特征均与公司现金股息支付概率呈显著负相关。基于这些发现，研究建议中国政府消除阻碍经济发展的区域与地理障碍，充分发挥市场力量在上市公司成长中的作用，并促进各方利益相关者的“共赢”格局。这些举措将有助于推动中国的经济发展，并为制定与有效实施合理的现金股息政策提供支持。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Research on ISDS Remedies and Burden of Proof for Sovereign Green Bond Defaults Caused by Government Greenwashing
papers.venue: Advances in Economics, Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: As an emerging branch of green finance, sovereign green bonds have received extensive attention in recent years. However, information asymmetry between host countries and investors, as well as the possibility of host countries engaging in greenwashing to maintain their international image, has led to losses of investors' investment interests. To address the issue of investor protection in sovereign green bonds, this paper takes the investment attribute of sovereign green bonds as the starting point and explores the ISDS remedy path for sovereign green bond defaults caused by government greenwashing. On this basis, it fully considers the difference in information acquisition capacity between investors and host countries, the diversity of implementing subjects, the dual identity of governments, the duality of damages, the complexity of causation, the misleading nature of government greenwashing and its high policy dependence in sovereign green bond defaults triggered by government greenwashing. It then explores the allocation of burden of proof between investors and host countries. Based on the general rules of burden of proof allocation in ISDS arbitration practice, this paper balances the burden of proof between investors and host countries through a reverse burden of proof system for causation, so as to realize the protection of investors' interests.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】作为绿色金融的一个新兴分支，主权绿色债券近年来受到了广泛关注。然而，东道国与投资者之间的信息不对称，以及东道国为维护自身国际形象而可能采取的“绿色洗白”行为，导致了投资者投资利益的受损。为了解决主权绿色债券中的投资者保护问题，本文以主权绿色债券的投资属性为出发点，探讨了因政府“绿色洗白”行为引发的主权绿色债券违约情况下的国际投资争端解决机制（ISDS）的救济途径。在分析过程中，本文充分考虑了投资者与东道国在信息获取能力上的差异、实施主体的多样性、政府的双重身份、损害的双重性、因果关系的复杂性、政府“绿色洗白”行为的误导性以及该行为在主权绿色债券违约中的高度政策依赖性。随后，本文探讨了投资者与东道国之间的举证责任分配问题。基于国际投资争端解决机制仲裁实践中关于举证责任分配的一般规则，本文通过建立反向举证责任制度来平衡投资者与东道国之间的举证责任，从而实现投资者利益的保护。。

papers.title: Different Mental Account of Different Age Stage
papers.venue: Advances in Economics, Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: Different mental account of different age stage is an important topic about behavioral finance, it is of key significance for better study of mental account. This article sorts out the research on the mental account of different ages and summarizes the progress of the main research from the two aspects of income mode and income distribution of different ages. On this basis, the existing studies still have insufficient impact of age on mental accounts. Some studies only write about the differences between some ages and mental accounts, but do not summarize the whole age stage. Future research should focus on the mental accounts of different ages and explore the application of financial distribution and risk control. By clarifying the psychological state of different age groups and the dynamic change laws, the paper can better build a reasonable financial model. And it can also provide more accurate evidence for financial products, pension financial management and national policies. Therefore, further research in the future should integrate the perspective of life cycle and systematically consider how age affects the distribution of funds and decision-making preferences through economic roles, cognitive ability and social environment.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】不同年龄阶段的心理账户特征是行为金融学中的一个重要研究课题，对于深入理解心理账户的运作机制具有重要意义。本文梳理了关于不同年龄段心理账户的研究成果，并从收入来源与收入分配两个维度总结了相关研究的进展。然而，现有研究在探讨年龄对心理账户影响的深度上仍存在不足：部分研究仅关注了特定年龄段之间的差异，未能全面反映整个年龄段的总体特征。未来的研究应重点关注不同年龄段的心理账户差异，并探索这些差异在金融资源配置与风险控制中的应用。通过明确不同年龄群体的心理状态及其动态变化规律，有助于构建更为合理的金融模型，同时为金融产品设计、养老金管理及国家政策制定提供更为精确的依据。因此，未来的研究应结合生命周期视角，系统性地分析年龄因素如何通过经济角色、认知能力和社会环境等因素影响个人的资金分配与决策偏好。。

papers.title: Elderly Health and Longevity in the US: Evidence and Implications
papers.abstract: Rising elderly life expectancy is a well-known source of fiscal pressure on Social Security and Medicare – but how have declining mortality and morbidity affected the two programs’ relative finances? Using nearly three decades of Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data (1992-2019), we estimate that these demographic changes raised expected lifetime Social Security spending by over twice as much as expected lifetime Medicare spending: 14% compared to 6%. The slower growth of elderly lifetime health care spending than annuity spending reflects two features of how longevity has increased: the additional 2.4 years of remaining life expectancy were entirely healthy – free of physical or cognitive limitations – while the expected amount of time spent with severe health limitations fell by about 30%, reducing expected lifetime nursing-home and home-health use. We then write down a stylized life-cycle model of a risk-averse retiree facing stochastic mortality and health to illuminate the key forces that affect the optimal allocation of a fixed amount of public funds across Medicare and Social Security.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】随着老年人预期寿命的延长，社会保障（Social Security）和医疗保险（Medicare）面临的财政压力日益增大。然而，死亡率和发病率的下降究竟如何影响了这两个项目的财务状况呢？我们利用近三十年的医疗保险受益人调查数据（1992-2019年）进行估算，发现这些人口结构变化导致的预期社会保障支出增长幅度是预期医疗保险支出增长幅度的两倍多：分别为14%和6%。老年人医疗保健支出增长速度低于养老金支出增长速度，这一现象反映了长寿带来的两个特点：其一，人们剩余的2.4年寿命完全处于健康状态（没有身体或认知方面的限制）；其二，预期需要依赖长期护理或居家医疗服务的时长减少了约30%。为此，我们构建了一个简化的生命周期模型，该模型模拟了面临随机死亡风险和健康风险的退休者的决策过程，以此揭示在固定公共资金分配给社会保障和医疗保险时所起的关键作用。。研究方法：调查数据、随机过程。

papers.title: AI Diffusion Gaps: Unequal Integration of AI Across K-12 Schools
papers.abstract: Although use of generative AI tools has quickly become widespread in education settings, emerging evidence suggests that effects on learning will depend on how that use is supported and guided. This paper reports findings from an original national survey of K-12 school principals designed to measure institutional integration of AI in schools through policies, teacher training, guidance for student use, leadership engagement, and the availability of AI-enabled tools. We find that AI use has spread rapidly across schools, largely as a productivity aid. Students mainly use AI for homework help and writing, while educators primarily use it for lesson planning and administrative tasks. The development of teacher training, guidance, and school policies has lagged adoption. We next document two diffusion gaps across schools: First, lower AI integration is associated with a higher share of disadvantaged students (a one standard deviation increase in disadvantage is associated with a 0.07-0.11 SD lower score on an index of AI integration); Second, private and charter schools score 0.23-0.44 SD lower on the AI integration index than traditional public schools. Although several surveyed school-level factors strongly predict AI integration, they do little to explain these gaps. Differences in district size account for roughly one-third of the disadvantage gap between public schools. These findings suggest that the factors associated with greater AI integration differ from those needed to narrow disparities in how schools support and guide AI use.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】尽管生成式人工智能工具在教育领域的应用已经迅速普及，但新的研究表明，其对学生学习的影响将取决于这些工具的应用方式是否得到了适当的支持与引导。本文基于一项针对K-12学校校长的全国性调查结果，该调查旨在通过政策、教师培训、学生使用指南、领导层参与度以及人工智能工具的可用性等方面来衡量学校在人工智能方面的整合程度。研究发现，人工智能工具在学校中的使用已经迅速普及，主要起到了提高工作效率的作用。学生主要利用人工智能工具辅助完成作业和写作任务，而教育工作者则将其用于课程规划和行政管理工作。然而，教师培训、使用指南以及学校相关政策的制定进展相对滞后。研究还发现了学校之间在人工智能应用方面的两个显著差异：首先，人工智能整合程度较低的学校中，弱势学生所占比例较高（弱势程度每增加一个标准差，学校在人工智能整合指数上的得分就会降低0.07至0.11个标准差）；其次，私立学校和特许学校的AI整合指数得分比传统公立学校低0.23至0.44个标准差。尽管调查中发现的多个学校层面因素能够显著预测学校的人工智能整合程度，但这些因素对于解释上述差异作用有限。地区规模的不同大约解释了公立学校之间在人工智能应用方...。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: The Informed Insider: A Leading Measure of Quality
papers.abstract: Product and service quality is fundamental to firm value creation, yet it is well recognized as difficult to observe ex ante. Existing quality proxies are limited in coverage, lack cross-firm comparability, and primarily rely on lagging indicators that capture product or service failures only after they materialize. Exploiting employees’ informational advantage as informed insiders and firsthand observers of firms’ internal operations, we develop and validate a novel, forward-looking measure of firm-year-level product and service quality using over 4.3 million employee reviews on Glassdoor. Leveraging machine learning models trained on a subset of firms with third-party customer satisfaction data, we construct quality indices for S&P 1500 firms spanning 2008 to 2023. The resulting quality measures exhibit meaningful variation across firms and within firms over time. In out-of-sample tests, our quality indices demonstrate strong predictive power for future quality provision, emerging as the single most important predictor relative to firm fundamentals and Glassdoor ratings. We validate our measure by examining its association with alternative quality metrics. We show that our quality measures are useful in predicting important quality-related firm outcomes such as product recalls, brand value, and profitability. We also construct an alternative set of quality measures using a zero-shot prompt-based approach and a supervised fine-tuning approach with GPT models to assess the potential of LLMs and generative AI in capturing firm-level quality provision. Our paper shows the value of employee voices as a powerful, forward-looking, and scalable signal of firm quality provision. The paper offers implications for stakeholders seeking to identify quality-related risks and opportunities before they become externally visible.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】产品和服务质量是企业创造价值的基础，然而人们普遍认为在事前很难对其进行有效评估。现有的质量评估指标存在覆盖范围有限、缺乏跨企业可比性等问题，且主要依赖于滞后指标，这些指标只能在产品或服务出现问题后才能反映出来。我们利用员工作为企业内部运营的知情者和直接观察者的信息优势，基于Glassdoor上超过430万条员工评价，开发并验证了一种新颖的、具有前瞻性的企业年度产品和服务质量评估方法。通过运用在包含第三方客户满意度数据的企业子集上训练的机器学习模型，我们为2008年至2023年间的标准普尔500指数成分股构建了质量指数。研究结果表明，不同企业之间的质量水平存在显著差异，且同一企业在不同时期的质量表现也存在变化。在样本外测试中，我们的质量指数在预测企业未来质量表现方面表现出很强的预测能力，成为仅次于企业基本面和Glassdoor评分的最重要预测因素。我们通过将其与其他质量指标进行关联分析来验证该评估方法的有效性，发现这些质量指标能够有效预测诸如产品召回、品牌价值及盈利能力等与企业质量密切相关的重要结果。此外，我们还采用基于零样本提示的方法以及基于GPT模型的监督微调技术，构建了另一套...。研究方法：机器学习。
